label: sampleRefusalHint
find: if let refused = cullError { throw LibraryRefusal(refused) }
replace: if cullError != nil { throw LibraryRefusal("Couldn't change the photo.") }

label: refusalChangesNothing
find: if let why = help(action) { throw LibraryRefusal(why) }
replace: if let why = help(action), case .setRating = action { throw LibraryRefusal(why) }
